summary: Kandal M Venture Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting to be held on July 9, 2026. The sole agenda item is a proposed share consolidation of every 16 existing shares (both Class A and Class B ordinary shares, par value $0.00001 each) into one share of par value $0.00016 each, effective no later than September 30, 2026. The board recommends approval and seeks authorization to implement the consolidation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic event; it is purely a capital structure adjustment. The proxy statement is routine, akin to a US proxy statement for a charter amendment. What to watch: shareholder vote outcome.
